definitions.gloss: right in front of; directly ahead; straight opposite
definitions.explanation: The position immediately and squarely in front of something, with no gap or offset. The intensifying prefix {真|ま} makes it stronger and more exact than plain {前|まえ}.

examples.english: It's right in front of the station.
A bus stopped right in front of my eyes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{真|ま}ん{前|まえ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦コンビニ→コンビニ：01081_konbini⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{買|か}い{物|もの}→買い物：00853_kaimono⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{困|こま}らない→困る：00861_komaru⟧。
examples.english: There's a convenience store directly in front of my house, so I never have trouble shopping.

notes:
The {真|ま} prefix here means "exactly, dead-on," the same {真|ま} as in ⟦{真|ま}ん{中|なか}→真ん中：00968_mannaka⟧ (dead center) and {真|ま}っ{直|す}ぐ (straight). Compared with plain ⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧, {真|ま}ん{前|まえ} insists that the thing is squarely opposite and very close.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{真|ま}ん{前|まえ}: right before one's eyes
- ⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{真|ま}ん{前|まえ}: right in front of the station
- {真|ま}ん{前|まえ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{座|すわ}る→座る：00757_suwaru⟧: to sit directly opposite
- {真|ま}ん{前|まえ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧: to stand squarely in front

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{正面|しょうめん}→正面：13189_shoumen⟧: the front, the facade — more formal and often refers to the front side of a building
- ⟦{手前|てまえ}→手前：01001_temae⟧: this side of, just before — nearer to the speaker, not opposite
- {真|ま}ん⟦{後|うし}ろ→後ろ：00683_ushiro⟧: directly behind — the matching opposite
